LAKOURWOW.Proposer: Install La Kour Warcraft content in this world? The guides (player and GM) and the starter adventure's maps will be imported; species, backgrounds, items and bestiary stay in the compendiums.
LAKOURWOW.StyleApplique: {n} map(s) or token(s) switched to the new style.
LAKOURWOW.Aide: Imports the module's guides and adventure maps into this world, and updates their plans.
LAKOURWOW.Explication: The guides (player and GM) and adventure maps are imported into the world; species, backgrounds, items, bestiary and generic locations stay in the compendiums. Nothing is deleted; an already imported document is not duplicated.
LAKOURWOW.Installer: Install the content in this world
LAKOURWOW.PasInstalle: Content not installed in this world yet.
LAKOURWOW.MauvaisSysteme: This world does not use D&D 5e: nothing to install.
LAKOURWOW.FureurRefusee: {objet}: refused. Fury Exhaustion still active on {noms}; wait for it to fade, or remove those creatures from your targets.
LAKOURWOW.FureurRetiree: {effet} removed from {nom}: this creature still carries Fury Exhaustion from an earlier use.
LAKOURWOW.Phase2: {nom} drops to {pv} HP out of {max}: phase 2! Use its phase 2 ability and place its new ground zones.
LAKOURWOW.LienChasseurTexte: AC, attack and damage: +{n} ({rodeur}'s proficiency bonus, minus the one the sheet already counts).
LAKOURWOW.FamilierLie: {familier} is bound to {rodeur}: its hit points and bonus now follow their level.
LAKOURWOW.FamilierInconnu: {nom} is not a hunter's companion (the module bestiary's "Familier du chasseur" sheet).
LAKOURWOW.RodeurSansCompagnon: {nom} lacks the Hunting Companion feature: no companion to bind.
LAKOURWOW.FamilierSansCible: Bind companion: target your companion's token first, then use the activity again.
LAKOURWOW.FleauRefuse: {activite}: refused. {noms} is neither undead nor a fiend; only those make this saving throw.
LAKOURWOW.FleauRetire: {effet} removed from {nom}: it is neither undead nor a fiend.
LAKOURWOW.RechargeInutile: {objet}: the use is not spent, nothing to regain.
LAKOURWOW.RechargeSansEmplacement: {objet}: the 5th-level spell slot must be spent to regain the use.
LAKOURWOW.PoigneSansPlace: Death Grip: no free space next to {chevalier} for {cible}; move it by hand.
LAKOURWOW.ArmeeSansJeton: Army of the Dead: no token of {nom} on a scene; place the ghouls by hand.
LAKOURWOW.ArmeeSansProfil: Army of the Dead: profile "{profil}" not found in the module bestiary; place the ghouls by hand.
LAKOURWOW.ArmeeIncomplete: Army of the Dead: {n} ghoul(s) placed out of {total}, for lack of free space within {portee} m.
LAKOURWOW.TotemLoin: {totem}: planted more than {portee} m from {nom}; move the template.
LAKOURWOW.IvressePropose: {assaillant} misses {moine} with a melee attack: Bottomless Drunkenness reaction available.
LAKOURWOW.IvresseInactive: Knock down the attacker: {nom}'s Bottomless Drunkenness is not active; nothing applied.
LAKOURWOW.IvresseRien: Knock down the attacker: no missed melee attack against {nom} is remembered; apply it by hand.

Etabli.Regle: Supplies are always spent. Success: the item is ready (one more copy of a consumable when beating the DC by 5 or more). Failure: components kept; failure by 5 or more: components lost too.
Etabli.Fabriquer: Roll the tool check and craft
Etabli.Aucune: No recipe found: is the module's "Guides and adventures" compendium available?
Etabli.SansOutil: You are not proficient with the tool: {outil}.
Etabli.SansOr: Not enough gold for the supplies ({po} gp).
Etabli.Reussite: {nom} crafts {produit} ({total} vs DC {dd}; {po} gp of supplies).
Etabli.ReussiteDouble: {nom} crafts two copies of {produit} ({total} vs DC {dd}, 5 or more above; {po} gp of supplies).
Etabli.Echec: {nom} fails to craft {produit} ({total} vs DC {dd}): {po} gp of supplies lost, components kept.
Etabli.EchecGrave: {nom} fails to craft {produit} by 5 or more ({total} vs DC {dd}): {po} gp of supplies and the components are lost.
Etabli.Erreur: Crafting bench: crafting interrupted ({message}). Details in the console (F12).
Etabli.SansActeur: Crafting bench: select your character's token, or assign your character in your settings.
Etabli.PasProprietaire: Crafting bench: you do not own {nom}'s sheet.
Etabli.DejaEnCours: Crafting bench: crafting is already in progress for {nom}.
Etabli.ProduitIntrouvable: Product not found in the module compendium: {produit}.
Etabli.Abandon: Crafting abandoned after the check, nothing was spent: {raisons}

LAKOURWOW.FamilierPasProprietaire: {utilisateur} does not own {nom}'s sheet: only its owner, or a GM, can bind it to a ranger.
